title: a figure for loss-decomp's stages.tbl
body: stages.tbl is one row per (unit, run) with a column per checkpoint: never seeded, seeded but absent from the table, scored below the family's cutoff, kept. Nothing draws it. A first attempt scattered wall clock against sensitivity and was rejected: this benchmark shows where in nail's pipeline the hits were lost, and a point per arm gives the total without saying which stage took it.
